title: Gerund, Infinitive, and Conditional Sentence — Level 10 — Final challenge

items.prompt: Which sentence about the science fair is grammatically correct?

visual.text: We are looking forward to presenting our project.

choices.say: We are looking forward to presenting our project.

visual.text: We are looking forward to present our project.

choices.say: We are looking forward to present our project.

visual.text: We look forward to present our project.

choices.say: We look forward to present our project.

visual.text: We are looking forward present our project.

choices.say: We are looking forward present our project.

items.reteach: Dalam "look forward to", kata "to" adalah preposisi, jadi diikuti gerund: to presenting.

items.prompt: Find the part that is kurang tepat: "She avoided to answer the question because she was not sure."
items.reteach: Avoid diikuti gerund: avoided answering.

items.prompt: Find the part that is kurang tepat: "If I had known about the traffic, I would leave home earlier."
items.reteach: Klausa if berbentuk past perfect (type 3), jadi hasilnya would have left.

items.prompt: Find the part that is kurang tepat: "The teacher made the students to rewrite their essays neatly."
items.reteach: Make + objek + bare infinitive: made the students rewrite.

items.prompt: Which sentence about the trip to Banyuwangi is correct?

visual.text: If it doesn't rain tomorrow, we will climb Ijen.

items.prompt: Find the part that is kurang tepat: "I wish I am taller so I could reach the top shelf."
items.reteach: Wish tentang keadaan sekarang memakai bentuk lampau: I wish I were taller.

items.prompt: Find the part that is kurang tepat: "Collect old newspapers is our class project this month."

items.prompt: Which sentence about Raka's plan is correct?

items.prompt: Find the part that is kurang tepat: "If he were here, he will help us carry the boxes."

items.prompt: Which sentence about the broken vase is correct?

items.prompt: Find the part that is kurang tepat: "My parents let me to stay up late on Saturday nights."

items.prompt: Find the part that is kurang tepat: "Sinta is proud of win the poetry competition last week."

items.prompt: Library rules: Which activity is NOT allowed in the library?

choices.say: Raka will cycle to Kenjeran Beach.

visual.text: Raka will buy a bigger bag.

choices.say: Raka will buy a bigger bag.

choices.say: Raka will stay at Dimas's house.

items.reteach: Kalimat type 1: if the weather is good, we will cycle to Kenjeran Beach.

choices.say: He does not have a kite.

items.reteach: "If I had a bigger bag" (type 2) berarti kenyataannya tasnya tidak cukup besar.

items.prompt: Raka's message: What is the purpose of the message?

stimulus.text: Hi Dimas, if the weather is good on Sunday, we will cycle to Kenjeran Beach. If I had a bigger bag, I would bring my kite too. Let me know if you want to join! - Raka

choices.say: to tell Dimas about the weather

items.reteach: Kalimat "Let me know if you want to join!" menunjukkan ajakan.

items.prompt: Diary: Why did the writer miss the train?

stimulus.text: Last Saturday I missed the train to Malang. If I had set my alarm, I wouldn't have overslept. I wish I had packed my bag the night before. Next time I will be ready.

items.reteach: "I wouldn't have overslept" menunjukkan kenyataannya penulis kesiangan.

items.prompt: Diary: What does the writer regret?

stimulus.text: Last Saturday I missed the train to Malang. If I had set my alarm, I wouldn't have overslept. I wish I had packed my bag the night before. Next time I will be ready.

visual.text: not packing the bag the night before

choices.say: not packing the bag the night before

items.reteach: I wish I had packed = penyesalan karena tidak menyiapkan tas.

items.prompt: Diary: What can we infer about the writer's alarm that night?

stimulus.text: Last Saturday I missed the train to Malang. If I had set my alarm, I wouldn't have overslept. I wish I had packed my bag the night before. Next time I will be ready.

visual.text: It was set for the wrong day.

choices.say: It was set for the wrong day.

items.reteach: "If I had set my alarm" (type 3) berarti kenyataannya alarm tidak dipasang.

items.prompt: English tips: Which tip is given in the text?

items.prompt: English tips: In "Don't be afraid of making mistakes", why is "making" used?

stimulus.text: Tips for Learning English: Keep practising every day. Try watching films with English subtitles. Avoid translating every word. Don't be afraid of making mistakes; they help you learn.

visual.text: because it comes after the preposition "of"

choices.say: because it comes after the preposition "of"

items.prompt: Ayu: "Shall we take the bus to Batu?" Sinta: "I'd rather not. I don't enjoy ___ on crowded buses."
items.reteach: Enjoy diikuti gerund: enjoy standing.

items.prompt: At a market in Madura. Seller: "These mangoes are sweet." Buyer: "If you ___ the price a little, I'll buy three kilos."
items.reteach: Type 1: klausa if memakai simple present (lower), hasilnya will (I'll buy).

items.prompt: Dimas: "Why are you so tired?" Raka: "The coach made us ___ fifty push-ups."
items.reteach: Make + objek + bare infinitive: made us do.

items.prompt: Teacher: "Why didn't you join the quiz?" Student: "I didn't know about it. If I ___ about it, I would have joined."
items.reteach: Type 3: If + had + verb 3, would have + verb 3.

items.prompt: Mother: "It's raining heavily." Son: "Oh no! I wish I ___ my umbrella at school today."
items.reteach: Penyesalan tentang kejadian yang sudah lewat memakai wish + past perfect.

items.prompt: Rina: "What are your plans after graduating?" Bayu: "I hope ___ medicine at Airlangga University."
items.reteach: Hope diikuti to-infinitive: hope to study.

items.prompt: Guest: "Do you mind if I open the window?" Host: "___ It's quite hot today."

visual.text: Yes, I do. Please open it.

choices.say: Yes, I do. Please open it.

items.reteach: Do you mind …? artinya "keberatankah?". Untuk mengizinkan jawab "Not at all / No, go ahead".

items.prompt: Sinta: "Would you go to Bali if you won a big prize?" Ayu: "No. If I won, I ___ the money for my education."
items.reteach: Type 2: If + simple past (won), would + verb 1.

items.prompt: Student A: "Why do you look so happy?" Student B: "Our teacher let us ___ the lesson outside today."
items.reteach: Let + objek + bare infinitive: let us have.

items.prompt: Raka: "Have you finished ___ your report?" Dimas: "Almost. Only the conclusion is left."
items.reteach: Finish diikuti gerund: finished writing.

items.prompt: Tour guide in Banyuwangi: "If you climb Ijen at 2 a.m., you ___ the blue fire." Tourist: "Great, we'll start early."
items.reteach: Type 1 untuk kemungkinan nyata: If + present, will + verb 1.

items.prompt: Ayu: "I feel nervous about the speech contest." Teacher: "Don't worry. Keep ___ in front of a mirror every day."
items.reteach: Keep diikuti gerund: keep practising.

items.prompt: Dina: "Why didn't you answer my call?" Fajar: "Sorry. I'm not used to ___ a phone with me yet."
items.reteach: Dalam "be used to", "to" adalah preposisi sehingga diikuti gerund: used to carrying.

items.prompt: Bayu: "Can we go swimming this afternoon?" Mum: "Only if you ___ your homework first."
items.reteach: Klausa if tentang masa depan tetap memakai simple present: if you finish.

items.prompt: Odd one out: Which verb is NOT followed by a gerund? enjoy, finish, avoid, hope

items.prompt: Odd one out: Which verb is NOT followed by a to-infinitive? want, refuse, plan, mind

items.prompt: Analogy: conditional type 1 : will = conditional type 2 : ___

items.prompt: Riddle: "I come after let and make, but I never take to or -ing." What am I?

items.prompt: Code: GERUND = 1, TO-INFINITIVE = 2, BARE INFINITIVE = 3. What is the code for the verb forms after "avoid", "want", and "let", in that order?
